name: How long does deck board replacement typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does deck board replacement typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of deck board replacement depends on the deck's size, the extent of the damage, and the type of materials being used. A small deck with minor board replacement might take a few days, while a larger deck requiring extensive board replacement could take a week or more. Weather conditions can also impact the timeline. Frasheski Construction can provide a more accurate time estimate after assessing your specific deck.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies by deck size, damage extent, and materials, typically from a few days to over a week. Weather can also affect the timeline.
